maintenance_findings.observation: One function mixes source extraction, environment/toolchain selection, debug/release build/install and many distinct runtime qualifications
maintenance_findings.recommendation: Extract build/install and coherent qualification phases; preserve one typed result and fail-closed publication status
maintenance_findings.performance: No SDK runtime performance claim; this is qualification tooling

maintenance_findings.observation: Large qualification coordinator with build/runtime/evidence responsibilities
maintenance_findings.recommendation: Use the same phase boundaries as C/Swift; avoid a generic workflow framework or duplicating validation

maintenance_findings.observation: Many diagnostic, canonical-marker, phase-order and final receipt checks in one parser
maintenance_findings.recommendation: Separate lexical admission, ordered phase verification and receipt assembly while retaining rejection controls

maintenance_findings.observation: Version membership tests are repeated across a decoder that supports multiple historical layouts
maintenance_findings.recommendation: A validated format-feature descriptor and per-entry parser could concentrate version knowledge; retain exact old-format acceptance/rejection tests; do not remove compatibility

maintenance_findings.observation: Database schema checks, MAC verification, nested version tags and semantic validation share one function
maintenance_findings.recommendation: Separate authenticated payload decoding from table admission, keeping authenticated bytes and final phase checks explicit

maintenance_findings.observation: Layouts, symbol descriptors and domain marshalling are concentrated in one internal native boundary
maintenance_findings.recommendation: Extract domain marshalling after common error/arena/symbol primitives; preserve one lifetime/error boundary and internal handles

performance_candidates.observation: Reservation owns plaintext and AD copies for each recipient, then encodes every recipient state before one durable aggregate persist. Maximum input bounds imply up to 32 * (16384 + 1024) = 557056 bytes of these payload copies, before other state and serialization
performance_candidates.claim_limit: Static input-copy accounting only; not measured live peak memory and not a bottleneck ranking
performance_candidates.recommendation: Measure actual installed send/resume allocation and sync cost versus recipient count; any shared representation must preserve durable original input/recovery/zeroization contracts

performance_candidates.observation: Current reserved-send path borrows pending plaintext/AD instead of cloning both merely to enter send; ciphertext creation still allocates a mutable buffer
performance_candidates.claim_limit: Do not repeat an old claim that every recovery entry point still clones both inputs; encryption output storage is not automatically avoidable

counterexamples.observation: Largest Python function is frozen literal receipt data with no branch points, not a control-flow hotspot

Long file is already cohesive around one exclusive lease state machine with bounded reconciliation. Optional internal module split can improve navigation, but length alone does not justify changing its ordering or safety checks
File total includes a large inline test module; total file LOC must not be reported as runtime code LOC

next_order: resolve actual installed Swift native crash with controlled build settings
phase extraction when touching current qualification flows, backed by existing negative controls
measure fanout input/serialization/persistence costs before changing representation
not_measured: native and foreign heap allocations for complete fanout

runtime_fix.problem: Combined bootstrap/reopen temporaries produced a 176336-byte outer Debug frame while reopening on Swift worker stack; original installed binary failed with SIGBUS
runtime_fix.change: Separate Bootstrap and Existing activation stages returning final heap-owned NativeOwner, without changing thread stacks, flags, protocol, authorization or persistence
runtime_fix.evidence: Same original Swift binary with same CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 native settings fails before fix; split passes complete original case; restoring 44352 bytes of caller stack pressure causes the same pre-readiness failure
runtime_fix.limits: Static frame comparison plus behavior controls, not total stack, peak RSS, throughput, or all platform qualification
